script_text: Stop, Gemini — Mercury squares Mars in the 3rd House of Communication today and the Air sign intensity is making every word feel dangerous. Venus in Cancer is forming a sextile with Jupiter flowing through your 10th House of Career, igniting a wave of authority and recognition. This aspect specifically activates opportunities connected to female figures in your professional life — pay attention. For single Geminis, this Venus-Jupiter sextile magnetizes someone emotionally intelligent — don't deflect their sincerity. If you're taken, a past disagreement quietly resolves itself when you stop overthinking the other person's intentions. Jupiter transiting your 10th House pushes your visibility skyward — pitch that unconventional project before Friday and watch how quickly doors open. A blessing arrives in the form of an unexpected text from someone you haven't heard from in over a year. Follow so you don't miss what's coming for Gemini this week.
